excerpt.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

label.zh: 异常研究结果（随机其一）

note.zh: 研究完成时按权重随机选出一个结果；每个结果对同一帝国默认只出现一次。

texts.zh: 沙漠星球[Root.GetName]似乎埋藏着一些秘密。
texts.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

sections.zh: 沙漠星球[Root.GetName]似乎埋藏着一些秘密。
sections.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]的沙丘下面，我们的科学团队找到了坠毁的战斗机舰队。虽然很古老，但是却保存的十分完好。它们早已经被遗弃，但是引擎和照明部件似乎还能运作。它们坠毁的原因目前尚不清楚。我们在旗舰的舰桥上面找到了舰队的人工智能，它能够在战斗中指挥这些船只，并且其仍在运作。我们靠近的时候，它拉响了警报。在入侵者靠近的时候它就会自动启动。
我们能够施行一个特殊项目在这个人工智能发疯之前回收它。我们也可以毁了它，避免未知的风险。
texts.en:
Under the dunes of [From.GetName] the science team has found a fleet of crashed fighters. Ancient, yet well preserved. They are abandoned, but the lights and engines seem to function. Why they crashed is a mystery. On the main ship bridge we found a fleet AI, capable of controlling the ships in battle. It is still active. As we approach a warning signal calls. It is programmed to activate when threatened by intruders!
A Special Project can be issued to try and salvage the AI before it goes haywire, or we could destroy it and avoid the risk.

label.zh: 试着去控制这个人工智能。
label.en: Try and take control of the AI.

label.zh: 在它试图做危险的事情之前毁了它。
label.en: Destroy it before it tries anything.

tooltips.zh:
毁掉这个人工智能。

把坠毁的人工智能舰队修正添加到[From.GetName]上：
£engineering£+2
tooltips.en:
Destroys the AI.

Adds the Crashed AI-Fleet modifier to [From.GetName]:
£engineering£ +2

texts.zh: 一支在沙漠星球上坠毁的古老舰队被发现了，她们的舰载AI仍然活跃。如果我们不去压制她，情况会急转直下。
texts.en: An ancient fleet has been found crashed on a desert planet, with a still-active shipboard AI. If we do not move to subdue it, things might take a turn for the worse.

texts.zh: 谢天谢地，我们成功地在人工智能攻击我们之前为它重新编写了程序。它目前已可作为我们舰队中的旗舰工作，并且如果我们愿意的话，它也可以成为指挥官。这个人工智能已经被运送到我们的母星，等待指派。
texts.en: Thankfully we were able to reprogram the AI before it turned on us. It has been repurposed to commandeer ships in our fleet, and could act as a sort of Commander if we so choose. The AI has been transported to our homeworld, awaiting assignment.

texts.zh: 我们未能阻止[From.From.GetName]上的飞舰载人工智能。他们的古船飞向遥远的天际，按照程序参数寻找下一个战场。
texts.en: We were unable to stall the fleet AI on [From.From.GetName]. Their ancient ships are taking to the skies and beyond, looking for the next battle according to their programmed parameters.

label.en: The rage of the machine is worth fearing.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[From.GetName]上有重大发现。该行星上的沙丘隐藏着一些废墟，是属于一个星际种群的。这类殖民地大都敌不过时间的洗礼。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]很快发现了一个藏有珍贵物品和文件的储物箱。既然这些文件是跟珍贵物品保存在一起，那一定相当重要。
texts.en:
On [From.GetName] the crew of the [Root.GetName] have found something extraordinary. The planet's dunes have hid several ruins, belonging to an interstellar civilization of settlers. The settlements have long been destroyed by the ravages of time.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is quick to discover a stored cache of valuables and documents. The collection of texts must have been most revered by the settlers, as they were stored amongst other valuables.

label.en: Send it to our homeworld for research.
Sell it to a private collector.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一摞文件，这似乎对一个已经消亡的社群很重要。翻译它们定能为我们提供更深入了解其历史与文化的机会。
texts.en: We have uncovered a stash of documents that seem to have been important to the now dead society. Translating them will surely provide us with a more in-depth look into its history and culture.

texts.zh: [From.From.From.GetName]上发现的文件似乎也是说书人特丽莎的著作。这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
texts.en: It seems that the text we found on [From.From.From.GetName] is another piece created by "Telisa the Teller of Tales."The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

texts.zh:
我们的语言专家废寝忘食数个月，终于成功翻译了[From.From.From.GetName]上找到的文献。这些文件是一位被称为说书人特丽莎的著作。她似乎是位非常有名的哲学家、社会学家、关系学家。

这些文件详细地解释如何重整基础设施和塑造社会。她的意思是所有人都牺牲自己的一部分幸福，为帝国共创美好的未来。
texts.en:
Having had our linguistics experts hard at work for months, we've finally succeeded in translating the works found on [From.From.From.GetName].The papers are the teachings of an alien scholar only referred to as "Telisa the Teller of Tales." All mentions of her points to her being a famous philosopher and overall expert on society and relations.

The documents explicitly details how you can refocus infrastructure and shape society. She meant that by having everyone sacrifice some of their comfort for the greater good the nation will flourish.

tooltips.zh: 可以使用大师的教诲：上上善道的帝国法令。
tooltips.en: Gives access to the Master's Teachings: The Greater Good Empire Edict.

texts.zh: 十分可惜，我们的语言学家未能完全理解[From.From.From.GetName]上古老文献的外星语言。不过，他们翻译了一些核心内容，让我们得以窥探那个文明的文化。
texts.en: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.

summary.text:
# 沙中迷藏 / Buried in the Sand

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:129-166` · `events/anomaly_events_3.txt:731-814 (4030-4031)` · `events/anomaly_events_3.txt:4005-4092 (4135-4136)` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:45-68, 374-397` · `events/failures.txt:163-231, 323-341`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 4级异常，每个帝国最多一次；在沙漠行星上以权重3生成。  
  Level-4 anomaly, at most once per empire; spawn weight 3 on desert planets.
- 约30天后另有一份通用联络报告（story.1–8，共享枢纽故事），不属于本故事。  
  About 30 days later a generic contact report (story.1–8, a shared hub story) follows; it is not part of this story.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 两个结果各基础权重1：  
  Two outcomes, base weight 1 each:
- **沙之仆人**（4030）：坠毁的远古战机舰队与仍在运行的舰队AI。尝试接管（禁止AI的帝国不可选）→ 30天项目（科研船+科学家，限时1080天）；或摧毁AI（行星获“AI舰队”修正与工程学资源点）。已找到过该AI的帝国权重0。  
  **The Servants of Sand** (4030): a crashed ancient fleet with an active AI. Try to take control (not if AI is outlawed) → 30-day project (1,080-day limit); or destroy it (planet modifier and engineering deposit). Weight 0 if the AI was already found.
- **殖民者的教诲**（4135）：沙丘下殖民者遗址中的文献；研究（1200社会学）或出售（能源与矿物）。格式塔或已找到此著作时权重0。  
  **Teachings of Settlers** (4135): documents in a settlers' ruins; research (1,200 society) or sell. Weight 0 for gestalts or if found.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 接管AI：成功 4031 获得3级机器人指挥官（好斗、舰队后勤专家）；超时失败 anomaly_failure.4031 AI舰队起飞成为敌对势力。  
  AI project: success 4031 gives a skill-3 robot commander; on timeout anomaly_failure.4031 the AI fleet launches as a hostile faction.
- 翻译：70% 4136 解锁法令“大师的教诲：大义”；30% anomaly_failure.4136 部分译出。  
  Translation: 70% 4136 unlocks "Master's Teachings: The Greater Good"; 30% anomaly_failure.4136.
- “大师的著作”系列：大陆上的发现、钢之追寻、沙中迷藏、潜在发现四个异常各可找到“讲述者泰丽莎”的一部著作并解锁对应法令；四者互不依赖、没有顺序，失败结果 anomaly_failure.4136 共用。完成时若已找到其他著作，成功事件使用另一段“又一部”文本。  
  "Master's Writings": Continental Findings, A Feel For Steel, Buried in the Sand and Cold Hard Potential can each yield one work of "Telisa the Teller of Tales" and its edict; they are independent and unordered, sharing the failure outcome anomaly_failure.4136. If another writing was found before, the success event uses its "more teachings" text.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别、4030/4031、4135/4136、两个项目与两个失败事件。  
  Category, 4030/4031, 4135/4136, both projects and failure events.
- 覆盖 Coverage：9 个文档全部核对 / all 9 docs checked.
